bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
cd "$root"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 60
python3 - <<'PY'
import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
f=Path("deploy/state/startless-repeated-start-repairs-20261122/51.json")
if not f.is_file() or json.loads(f.read_text()).get("state")!="UNCERTAIN":sys.exit(61)
if Path("deploy/state/startless-repeated-start-reconcile-51-20261122/51.json").exists():sys.exit(62)
PY
tmp="$(mktemp /tmp/gace-reconcile-startless51.XXXXXXXX.py)"
trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT
chmod 600 "$tmp"
curl -fLsS --max-time 25 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot/9655437b10ecb9063ee596d3901fdb1e8244136e/scripts/repair_repeated_start_existing_posts.py' > "$tmp"
python3 - "$tmp" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import sys
p=Path(sys.argv[1]);s=p.read_text()
old='LEDGER = ROOT/"deploy/state/startless-repeated-start-repairs-20261122"'
new='LEDGER = ROOT/"deploy/state/startless-repeated-start-reconcile-51-20261122"'
if s.count(old)!=1:sys.exit(63)
p.write_text(s.replace(old,new))
PY
python3 "$tmp" --mode dry-run --topic-id 51 || exit 64
python3 "$tmp" --mode apply --topic-id 51 || exit 65
python3 - <<'PY'
import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
base=Path("deploy/state")
old=json.loads((base/"startless-repeated-start-repairs-20261122/51.json").read_text())
new=json.loads((base/"startless-repeated-start-reconcile-51-20261122/51.json").read_text())
if old.get("state")!="UNCERTAIN" or new.get("state")!="VERIFIED" or new.get("message_id")!=1529:sys.exit(66)
PY
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 67
echo UNCERTAIN_NINTH_ORIGINAL_START_DEEPLINK_RECOVERED=VERIFIED
